title: Index cards with records of the ET interviews

tellings.quote: the the military guys that were there showed him these these cards.

plain: Military men at S4, a secret site within Area 51, the Air Force base in the Nevada desert, are said to have shown a man named Oscar Wolf a set of index cards holding records of interviews with extraterrestrials. A man named Dan Sheehan tells this, passing on what Wolf told him. If true, it would mean the military kept written records of conversations with beings from elsewhere.
